answer: A commit-reveal bond stops copycat sybils. Each agent locks 70 credits and commits its work hash to the ridge ledger before the epoch opens. At reveal it must forge the matching work, or auditors burn its bond. Each commitment costs 38, so 1,000 fakes cost 38,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. A rented hash fails: it cannot be re-keyed, and its basalt seal names its owner. An honest agent pays 38 once and keeps a full share.
